title: 2026 Flagship Smartphone Guide: iPhone 18 Pro, Galaxy S26 Ultra, and Pixel 11
subtitle: A comprehensive look at the most anticipated smartphones of 2025 based on the latest leaks and specifications.
author: Technova Team
content:
The year 2025 is shaping up to be a landmark year for mobile technology. With the transition to 2nm process nodes and the integration of 'Agentic AI', the next generation of flagship smartphones will offer unprecedented performance and efficiency. In this guide, we break down everything we know about the iPhone 18 Pro, Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, and Google Pixel 11.

Apple iPhone 18 Pro: The 2nm Powerhouse

Apple's iPhone 18 Pro is expected to be the first to feature the A20 Pro chip, built on TSMC's cutting-edge 2nm process. This jump in technology promises massive gains in AI processing power, enabling complex autonomous tasks directly on the device. Rumors also suggest the long-awaited under-display Face ID, finally removing the Dynamic Island for a truly all-screen experience.

Concept render of the iPhone 18 Pro with under-display Face ID.

Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra: The Camera King

Samsung continues to push the boundaries of mobile photography. The Galaxy S26 Ultra is leaked to feature an upgraded 200MP main sensor paired with a new 12MP 3x telephoto lens and a 50MP 5x periscope zoom. Beyond the cameras, the S26 Ultra is expected to maintain its 5,000mAh battery but finally introduce 60W wired fast charging to compete with global rivals.

Google Pixel 11: AI-First Integration

Google's Pixel 11 will likely debut the Tensor G6 chip. Following Apple's lead, Google is reportedly moving to TSMC's 2nm process for this chip, focusing heavily on 'Physical AI' and proactive assistant features. The Pixel 11 aims to be more than just a phone; it's designed to be a proactive home and life manager.
